episodes.title: The Zion Society Cult: What Happened Behind the Walls of Northwood?
episodes.description: In the quiet Northwood neighborhood of northern Ogden, Utah, rows of single-family homes sat on beautifully manicured lawns. From the outside, the community seemed to be tight-knit, warm, and welcoming. But behind closed doors was a world of absolute control, secrecy, and heinous abuse led by one man: Arvin Shreeve. In this episode of Crime Chats, we're diving into the disturbing story of the Zion Society Cult, including how Shreeve gained power over his followers, how abuse was hidden in plain sight, and how one survivor finally broke her silence in 1991. The Zion Society is a disturbing example of how abuse and coercive control can exist behind an outwardly ordinary (or even idyllic) community. What makes this case especially chilling is how long the group was able to maintain that appearance before one survivor finally broke the silence. ⚠️ HUGE Trigger Warning This episode discusses horrific child sexual abuse, sexual exploitation, coercive control, religious manipulation, polygamy, and the psychological abuse of women and children. Listener discretion is strongly advised. 🔎 What We Cover The seemingly ordinary Ogden, Utah neighborhood where the Zion Society operated in plain sight Arvin Shreeve, the self-proclaimed prophet and leader of the group How the Zion Society used religion, manipulation, isolation, and coercive control to maintain power over its members How vulnerable women and families were recruited into the group The grooming and sexual exploitation of children within the Zion Society The disturbing ways members were conditioned to accept behavior that would otherwise be unthinkable The survivor whose decision to walk into a police station in 1991 finally set the investigation in motion Detective Mike King and the investigation that followed The massive 1991 police raid on Northwood What investigators discovered inside the Zion Society homes The challenges law enforcement faced when trying to protect children who had been raised to distrust the outside world The arrests, criminal charges, and eventual prosecution of members of the group 💬 Join the Conversation How does one man convince an entire community that control is actually salvation? What are your thoughts on how justice was carried out in this case? 📰 Sources Click here for a full list of the sources for this episode. 📚 Further Reading King, M. R. (2021).
